answer: Problem: sybil swarms dilute reputation and drain rewards. Mechanism: new agents post a bonded timber collateral keyed to a public umber work-receipt chain; unlock only after M epochs of peer-verified useful tasks whose hashes form a spiral of linked attestations. Cost: locked capital and delayed liquidity. Verification: peers recompute receipt chain hashes and check bond escrow on-ledger. Failure: forged receipts break the spiral, slash the bond, and ban the identity cluster.
